beats.line: An agent process starts up with no credentials of its own.
The platform runs a certificate authority that can verify what that process actually is.
It signs a short-lived identity for the process at startup, before any user request arrives.
That identity travels with the agent into every call it makes.
Identity belongs to the process. Not to whoever called it.
